Collaborate with multi-functional teams to define operational requirements and support strategic infrastructure initiatives. Deep expertise supporting WAN and routing topologies, datacenter switching architectures, firewall technologies, and traffic management platforms. Demonstrable experience supporting secure hybrid multi-cloud environments including AWS, GCP, and Azure networking services. Strong troubleshooting skills across network, operating system, and application layers. Advanced knowledge of networking protocols and technologies including Ethernet (10/40/100/400Gbps), OSPF, BGP, IPSec, DHCP, DNS, SNMP, LACP, IPv6, TCP, and Spanning Tree technologies. Hands-on experience supporting enterprise networking platforms including Cisco Catalyst and Nexus, Dell Force10, Arista, Citrix NetScaler, and F5 BIG-IP technologies. Expertise supporting traditional and next-generation firewall technologies using Cisco and Palo Alto Networks solutions. Good communication skills with the ability to document troubleshooting procedures, operational standards, and technical solutions effectively. Good understanding of security frameworks and regulations including ISO 27001, NIST, and PCI DSS. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and drive operational issues through resolution with minimal supervision. Demonstrable experience leading incident response activities and conducting root cause analysis across complex distributed environments. Familiarity with observability platforms, dashboard creation, capacity planning, and actionable alerting strategies. Ability to mentor junior team members and lead technical discussions across multi-functional teams. Certifications from major cloud platforms, Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, or other industry-recognized technologies are preferred. Strong leadership capabilities with a passion for mentoring teams and driving continuous operational improvement.

The team specializes in post-surgery rehabilitation, elderly mobility support, injury recovery, and pain management, all provided in the comfort of clients’ homes. Role Description The Physiotherapist will provide high-quality, evidence-based physiotherapy services to clients, focusing on assessment, treatment, and rehabilitation in an on-site setting in Vijayawada. This full-time role involves conducting detailed physical assessments, developing individualized treatment plans, and delivering therapeutic interventions to support recovery, mobility, and pain management. The Physiotherapist will monitor progress, adjust treatment plans as needed, and maintain accurate clinical records in line with professional standards. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Physiotherapy from a recognized institution and valid professional registration/license as required. Commitment to ethical practice, patient safety, ongoing professional development, and adherence to evidence-based treatment guidelines. Experience in home-based or community physiotherapy settings is an advantage; familiarity with geriatric and post-operative populations is highly beneficial.

Clarity over Noise: We communicate honestly and focus on what moves performance. Human First: We treat clients and teammates as partners, with care and transparency. Curiosity & Growth: We test, learn, and improve. We want you to be hands-on and evolving. Vision: We believe great performance marketing should be accessible to EVRYone. The Role We are hiring a Creative Designer to join our growing creative team. You will report to the Marketing Manager and work closely with our Creative team, PPC team, and founders to create high-performing creative assets across a wide range of client accounts. This is primarily a design role, however we are looking for someone who is curious and eager to expand their skill set over time. You will have opportunities to learn and support areas such as social media scheduling, email marketing, website updates, and broader digital marketing operations. We care less about whether you've done everything before, and more about your eye for design, willingness to learn, attention to detail, and ability to take ownership of your work. What We Are Looking For (Must-have) Strong graphic design skills with a portfolio that demonstrates creativity, attention to detail, and strong visual communication. Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign. Proven experience designing for social media, including organic content, paid ads, carousels, stories, reel covers, campaign visuals, and other digital assets. Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects across different brands while maintaining consistency, quality, and meeting deadlines. Ability to work from creative briefs, ask the right questions, and translate ideas into polished, effective creative, while also bringing your own recommendations and ideas to the table. Excellent communication skills and the ability to receive, interpret, and implement feedback effectively. A proactive mindset that values quality, consistency, continuous improvement, and a genuine interest in learning and contributing new ideas. Nice To Have Familiarity with website and email platforms such as Figma and Canva but also Shopify, WordPress, Elementor, Wix, Squarespace and Privy. Experience designing email marketing assets such as newsletter layouts, promotional emails, banners, product blocks, and branded templates. Experience or interest in website and landing page design, with a basic understanding of UX, mobile-first principles, and conversion-focused design. Understanding of paid social creative best practices, especially for Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok, and ecommerce campaigns. Video editing skills for short-form content, reels, paid social ads, motion graphics, or simple animated assets. Experience using AI tools to develop creative concepts, imagery and video assets for client campaigns What You Will Be Responsible For: 1) Creative design delivery (primary) Design social media content including graphics, carousels, stories, reel covers, and content templates for EVRY and client accounts. Create assets for paid advertising campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Google Display, and other digital platforms. Design email marketing assets including newsletters, campaign banners, promotional sections, and branded templates. Create website graphics, presentations, and other marketing collateral as required. Adapt creative concepts across multiple formats, platforms, sizes, and placements while maintaining brand consistency. Support branding projects including visual identities, style guides, and brand assets. 2) Website & Digital Support (Secondary) Support website and landing page projects across platforms such as WordPress, Shopify, Squarespace and Wix. Create and optimise website graphics, including banners, icons, product imagery, mockups, and page layouts to support a consistent user experience. Ensure email and website designs are mobile-friendly, visually consistent, and aligned with each client's brand and customer journey. Bring an interest in website building and digital experience design, with a willingness to grow in this area. 3) Creative Operations & Quality Assurance Follow client brand guidelines and maintain EVRY's creative standards across all deliverables. Check all work carefully before delivery, including spelling, alignment, formatting, image quality, and export settings. Organise files and maintain clear naming conventions, templates, and internal design resources. Support the preparation and formatting of content and creative assets for client approval and publication. Contribute with creative ideas, visual references, and recommendations during strategy discussions and team collaboration. Continuously develop new skills across design, digital marketing, and creative operations. The Ideal Person You are a detail-focused designer who cares about clean layouts, strong visual hierarchy, and purposeful design. You enjoy working across different brands, understanding what makes each one distinct, and creating digital assets that feel thoughtful, polished, and effective. You are organised, curious, and open to feedback. You can work independently, but you also enjoy collaborating with a team that values clarity, quality, and continuous improvement. Why Join EVRY? Work remotely from anywhere in a flexible environment built around trust, ownership, and outcomes. Join a fast-growing agency working with brands across Australia, where your work has real impact and your ideas are valued. Collaborate directly with experienced marketers, designers, and founders in a supportive and ambitious team. Expand your skills beyond design through ongoing learning, professional development, and exposure to broader digital marketing. Enjoy generous paid time off, local public holidays, an annual Christmas shutdown, and performance-based bonus opportunities as the agency grows. Although our clients are predominantly located within Australia, our team is mostly based across the EU, so working hours will need to align slightly with EU working hours ie. 8am - 4pm CET.

The Ideal Profile: Passion & Mindset Demonstrated Passion for Technology & AI The "First to Know": You are a true technophile. You don't just wait for training; you are already experimenting with the latest in Generative AI, LLMs, and Agentic workflows. AI Visionary: You have a clear passion for how AI is transforming the workforce. You are eager to show customers how Agentforce and autonomous agents can augment human productivity. Continuous Learner: You have a "Growth Mindset." Responsibilities Strategic Sales Partnership: Act as the technical "North Star" for the sales team, aligning technical strategy with business outcomes to close complex deals. Solution Innovation: Develop and deliver innovative custom solutions and demos (including Agentforce and Data Cloud) that address unique business challenges and prove tangible value. Lead the Cycle: Coordinate and lead the entire solution cycle through close collaboration with other high-performing teams (Product, Marketing, Professional Services). Value Communication: Articulate the benefits of Salesforce to audiences at every level—from IT Administrators to C-suite executives—using industry-specific insights. Continuous Growth: Maintain expert-level knowledge of Salesforce products and industry trends to remain effective in a performance-driven environment. Experience & Background We are looking for a diverse range of backgrounds to join our high-performing South team. Whether you are a career SE or looking to pivot your technical and business acumen into a pre-sales career, we want to hear from you. Core Experience (One Or More Of The Following) Solution Excellence: A proven track record in Solution Engineering (Pre-sales), technical consulting, or professional services delivery within an enterprise software organization. Strategic Sales & Account Management: Experience in Account Management or Solution Selling, with a focus on navigating complex sales cycles and acting as a strategic partner to sales leadership. SaaS & Cloud Fluency: Deep familiarity with the SaaS (Software as a Service) landscape, including an understanding of subscription-based business models and cloud architecture. Consultative Mindset: A background in Business Consulting, with the ability to perform deep discovery, identify "pain points," and map them to high-value technology roadmaps. Technical Foundation: A strong Technical Background—this could be a degree in CS/Engineering or equivalent hands-on experience with APIs, data modeling, or software development. Required Skills & Qualifications The Foundations Professional Background: A track record in Solution Engineering, SaaS, Account Management, Management Consulting, or a deep Technical Background. We are open to a variety of backgrounds if you can demonstrate the core proficiencies of the role. Strategic Partnering: Experience acting as a strategic partner to sales or business units, helping to steer the direction of a deal or project. Demonstrated Passion: A visible passion for Technology, Business, and AI. You are curious about the latest trends and eager to learn how they apply to customer success. Problem-Solving: Exceptional ability to find creative, pragmatic solutions to unique and complex business challenges. Key Professional Skills Stakeholder Management: Ability to manage and influence internal and external stakeholders, navigating different interests to reach a common goal. Communication & Presence: Strong oral, written, and presentation skills. You are good at explaining complex ideas and finding ways to keep an audience’s attention. Prioritisation: Strong organizational and time-management skills to manage multiple high-priority projects simultaneously in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Experience & Adaptability Industry Insight: Ability to understand business requirements within multiple industries and translate them into a compelling vision and roadmap. Agility: Comfortable working as part of a team to tackle problems in energizing environments and willing to travel occasionally. Language Requirements Fluency in English plus one or more additional languages is required from the following: Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Hebrew, Arabic, French or one of the main Eastern European languages (e.g., Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, Czech, Romanian, Hungarian). SaaS Mastery: Experience or background in solution selling and the enterprise software landscape. Education: Degree or equivalent proven experience (including extracurricular leadership, military experience, or volunteer roles). Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. new_matches.description: Do you thrive in B2B sales and love turning conversations into long-term partnerships? Are you motivated by achieving results, eager to take ownership, and looking for an environment where your efforts are valued and your work truly makes an impact? Do you enjoy building meaningful client relationships and seeing the tangible results of your work? If that sounds like you, keep reading. Your Mission To support our ambitious growth plans, we are seeking an experienced Account Executive to be part of our expansion journey into the UK market . In this role, you will play a pivotal part in helping businesses grow by owning the entire B2B sales cycle, contribute to our growth by opening accounts in the UK and benefiting from an attractive commission structure and plenty of career growth opportunities in B2B Sales & Business Excellence. In This Role, You Will Prospecting: Identify and qualify potential clients to build a strong sales pipeline. Business Development: Drive outreach through phone, email, and LinkedIn to create new business opportunities. Consultative Sales: Conduct in-depth needs assessments to uncover customer pain points and present tailored solutions. Client relations: Build trust and credibility by demonstrating expertise and delivering value. Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams to achieve shared goals. Full Sales Cycle Ownership: Manage the entire sales process, from initial outreach to closing deals. Account Growth: Take full ownership of the accounts you win—managing and expanding them over time. What We’re Looking For Proven track record of working towards/in the UK market in B2B sales. Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, in English (native level). A proactive, results-driven approach and ambition to grow in an international environment. Ability to build trust, credibility, and long-term client relationships. What We Offer Performance rewarded: You’ll receive an attractive compensation package with base salary, commission, and an additional starter bonus to support you as you ramp up and build your sales pipeline. Growth and learning: From day one, you’ll benefit from a four-week onboarding program and continuous coaching through our international AL Academy, ensuring you’re always developing and moving forward in your career. Career opportunities across Europe: As we continue to grow, you’ll have the chance to explore international opportunities. With offices in Helsinki, Amsterdam, Antwerp, Copenhagen, Berlin, Stockholm, Kuala Lumpur, and Barcelona, your career can take you anywhere. Recharge & Thrive: We care about your well-being and want you to stay energized both inside and outside of work. That’s why you can earn up to 12 extra vacation days each year and enjoy local perks such as gym and massage discounts, along with other wellness benefits. Curious about the details in your location? Ask your recruiter to learn more. We win together: Collaboration is our driving force, and every success is shared. That’s why we love bringing people together through company trips, international events, and local office celebrations — whether it’s hitting the slopes in Levi, running the Berlin Marathon together, or celebrating milestones across our offices in Europe. Annual company trip: Every summer, all employees from our different offices come together in Finland for an exciting company trip - a mix of team building, knowledge exchange, and celebrations. Global Community & Diversity: Diversity is part of our DNA. With colleagues from over 50 nationalities, you’ll join an international community where every culture, perspective, and background fuels innovation and success. Recruitment Process Screening video call with our Recruitment Team. First interview with the Hiring Manager. Second interview (including a short role-play) with the Team Manager. Reference check and/or short personal assessment Please submit your CV in English. At Aurora Live , we’re transforming the way leaders connect, collaborate, and grow. Working with us means being part of an international, fast-paced, and purpose-driven company , where ambition meets action and every idea can make an impact. Our teams bring together smart, curious, and driven individuals who love what they do — connecting visionary leaders, shaping industries, and celebrating success along the way. Ready to be part of something extraordinary? Join us and help shape the future of business connections.
